% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpMarkupMultiSlides[repository=/docs/components/markup-multi-slides/docs,label=Mixed markup slides]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/markup-multi-slides/markup-multi-slides.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-markup-multi-slides");
element1.setAttribute("repository", "/docs/components/markup-multi-slides/docs");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Mixed markup slides");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Slides navigation menu
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpMarkupMultiSlides[repository=/docs/components/markup-multi-slides/docs,label=Mixed markup slides,menu]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Automatic notes
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpMarkupMultiSlides[repository=/docs/components/markup-multi-slides/automatic/html,auto=notes,timing=5000,label=Automatic notes]{}
\end{document}
